copy.tagline: 在后台定时发送网络请求检查服务状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要定期检测服务是否在线
copy.tagline_en: Send periodic network pings to check service status
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to periodically check if a service is online

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在后台启动一个任务，然后继续做其他工作。当后台任务有进展或写完输出文件时，系统会通过提醒通知你，你只需在收到提醒后检查文件即可。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 执行一个后台任务（设置 run_in_background=true）时触发。之后 Claude 会立即继续处理其他任务，直到系统提醒后台任务完成。

say.text: 后台运行一个脚本，结果保存到 agents/script/output.md

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can launch a background agent and continue working on other tasks. The system will notify you via reminders when the agent makes progress or writes an output file. You only need to check the file when reminded.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to run a task with run_in_background=true. Claude will immediately proceed to other tasks until the system reminds you of the background agent's progress or completion.

say_en.text: Search the web in background, output to .claude/cache/agents/search/output.md
say_en.note: Claude starts a background task and continues answering your other questions.

say_en.text: Run a script in background, save results to agents/script/output.md
say_en.note: Claude returns immediately; you can chat while waiting for the system reminder.
